why: Ratchet. The gate fails if fewer tools carry a backend-response fixture than minimumCoveredTools, or fewer LEGACY-shaped cases than minimumLegacyCases — deleting or renaming a fixture can no longer shrink the scanned surface in silence. Raise them (never lower them) as fixtures are added; lowering either must be a deliberate edit in the same diff as the removal, with the reason recorded here.
